projects.name: Hampton, Georgia data center
projects.quote: In January, Equinix contributed the Hampton, Georgia asset to its xScale joint venture in the United States, an important first step to deploying $15 billion of capital with its JV partners in major metros, and enabling the JV to enter a lease arrangement with a customer.
